unresolved_identity.reason: The single catalogue description does not establish whether this was a formal award rather than a talismanic or commemorative medal.

SALT records a 37 mm gold object (ANUDM00126) and a bronze obverse trial (ANUDM00127), so this is not merely an unidentified Crimea-related name. SALT also states that the medal was very likely never awarded; it therefore remains outside the formal-award count pending stronger issuance evidence.
